# Castro Finish Carpentry

> Finish carpentry and exterior repair contractor based in Sandwich, Massachusetts, serving all of Cape Cod (from Sandwich to Provincetown) and Plymouth since 2013. Licensed (HIC/CSL) and insured in MA, BBB accredited, rated 5.0 stars on Google (61 reviews). Free on-site estimates.

- Phone: (508) 566-1618
- Email: ecastrocarpentry@gmail.com
- Address: 15 Jan Sebastian Dr, Unit 4, Sandwich, MA 02563
- Founder: Estevam Castro
- Free estimate: https://castrocarpentryinc.com/contact-us/

## Services

- [Trim & finish carpentry](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/trim/): Repairs, replacement and detailed finishing inside and out. Straight lines, tight joints, clean transitions, and hidden rot fixed before we close up.
- [Siding repair & installation](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/siding/): Cracked, loose or warped sections replaced with proper flashing and sealing, plus rot repair around trim and corners.
- [Decks, repairs & upgrades](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/decking/): New builds, rebuilds, board replacement, railings, stairs and refinishing in wood or composite, framed square and fastened tight.
- [Windows & doors](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/windows-and-doors/): Windows and doors installed as a system: flashing, sealing, and square, level framing to stop drafts and leaks, finished with clean trim.
- [Roofing repairs](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/roofing/): Leaks stopped at the source: damaged shingles, flashing at chimneys, skylights and valleys, storm repairs and preventive fixes.
- [ADUs & garage conversions](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/adu/): Garage conversions, in-law suites, attached additions and backyard cottages, now allowed by right in most Massachusetts single-family zones.

## Service areas

- [Sandwich, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/sandwich-ma/): Our shop is here in Sandwich. Trim, siding, decks, windows and doors, roof repairs and ADUs for homes in Sandwich Village, East Sandwich, Forestdale and South Sandwich.
- [Dennis, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/dennis-ma/): Decks, exterior trim, siding, windows and doors for homes in Dennis Village, East Dennis, South Dennis, West Dennis and Dennis Port, with a clear, itemized estimate.
- [Orleans, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/orleans-ma/): Exterior trim, decks, cedar shingle siding, windows and doors for homes in Orleans village, East Orleans and South Orleans, from Nauset to Pleasant Bay.
- [Chatham, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/chatham-ma/): Exterior trim, decks, windows and doors, and cedar shingle siding for homes in Chatham, North Chatham, South Chatham, West Chatham and Chathamport.
- [Provincetown & Truro, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/provincetown-truro-ma/): Exterior trim, decks, cedar shingle siding, windows and doors for homes and rentals in Provincetown and Truro, including North Truro.
- [Plymouth, MA](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/service-areas/plymouth-ma/): Decks, exterior trim, windows and doors, and siding for homes in downtown Plymouth, North Plymouth, Manomet, Cedarville, White Horse Beach and the Pinehills.
- Also serving: Bourne, Falmouth, Mashpee, Barnstable & Hyannis, Yarmouth, Brewster, Harwich, Eastham, Wellfleet.

## Guides

- [Wood vs. Composite Decking for Cape Cod Homes](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/blog/wood-vs-composite-decking-cape-cod/): Pressure-treated, cedar, hardwood or composite? Compare cost, upkeep, heat, salt air and looks to choose the right decking for your Cape Cod home.
- [Cedar Shingle Siding on Cape Cod: Repair or Replace?](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/blog/cedar-shingle-siding-repair-or-replace/): Grey cedar isn't failing cedar. The signs that shingles need a repair or a full re-shingle, and what a proper cedar siding job on Cape Cod includes.
- [Building an ADU on Cape Cod: What Homeowners Need to Know](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/blog/building-an-adu-on-cape-cod/): Massachusetts now allows ADUs by right in single-family zones. What changed, what still applies on Cape Cod, like septic and historic review, and how it works.
- [7 Signs Your Exterior Trim Is Rotting (and What to Do About It)](https://castrocarpentryinc.com/blog/signs-of-rotting-exterior-trim/): Peeling paint at joints, soft spots, dark stains and open corners are early signs of trim rot. How to spot them on a Cape Cod home and what to do next.
